questions.question: The product of velocity and time gives:

• The product of velocity and time gives **Displacement__**.

questions.question:
Consider the following question and decide which of the statements is sufficient to answer the question.

Question: 

Mika is the niece of Mahi. Determine the present ages of Mika and Mahi.

Statements:

1. Their mean age is 27.

2. After 15 years, Mahi’s age will be twice that of Mika’s.

options.text: Statement 1 and 2 together are not sufficient

questions.solution:
Let Mika and Mahi ages be a and b years respectively.

Statement 1:

⇒ (a + b)/2 = 27

⇒ a + b = 54 ----(1)

Statement 2:

After 15 years,

⇒ (a + 15) = 2(b + 15)

⇒ a + 15 = 2b + 30

⇒ a – 2b = 15 ----(2)

By solving equations (1) and (2) both we can get the respective age of Mahi and Mika

∴ Statement 1 and 2 together are sufficient

questions.question: If the frequency of a wave is doubled then its wavelength will be:

f = Frequency

questions.question: Pipe A can empty a filled tank in 5.6 hours while Pipe B can fill the same tank in 7 hours when it is empty. If Pipes A and B are alternately turned on for an hour each time, starting when the tank is full, how long will it take to empty the tank?
questions.solution:
Let the capacity of the tank be 28 units. (By taking L.C.M. of 5.6 and 7)

Efficiency of pipe A = 28/5.6 = -5

Efficiency of pipe B = 28/7 = 4

Work done by both pipes in 2 hours = -5 + 4 = -1 unit

At the last hour, pipe A will work alone, hence 5 units will be done by pipe A.

Remaining work i.e. 28 - 5 = 23 units are done by Pipe A and Pipe B.

∴ Time taken = 23 × 2 = 46 hours

∴ It will take 46 + 1 = 47 hours to empty the tank.

questions.question: A cone of diameter 14 cm and height 24 cm is placed on top of a cube of side 14 cm. Find the surface area of the whole figure.
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cone diameter = 14 cm, Height = 24 cm

Cube of side = 14 cm

**Formula used:**

Curved surface area of cone = π × Radius × Slant height 

Surface area of cube = 6 × side2 

Slant height = √(height2 + radius2)

Area of circle = π × radius2

**Calculation:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/1203e410f35f13327f1a6383d9652660da2f705f6317eb70c3f53171e9939fb7.png] 

Slant height = √(height² + radius²) = √(24² + 7²) = 25

Curved surface area of cone = π × Radius × Slant height = (22/7) × 7 × 25 = 550 cm²

Surface area of cube = 6 × side² = 6 × (14)² = 1176 cm²

But some area covered by cone's base = π × radius2

⇒ (22/7) × 7² = 154 cm²

⇒ Total surface area = 550 + 1176 - 154 = 1,572 cm²

questions.question: Raju gained a profit of 6% by selling a washing machine for Rs. 689. What was the cost price of the washing machine?
questions.solution:
**Short trick:**

Cost price = 689/1.06 = Rs. 650

**Detailed solution:**

⇒ Profit % = {(Selling price/Cost price) – 1} × 100

⇒ 6 = {(689/Cost price) – 1} × 100

⇒ 0.06 = (689/Cost price) – 1

⇒ 1.06 = 689/Cost price

⇒ Cost price = 689/1.06

⇒ Cost price = Rs. 650

questions.question: The lens formula is ________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**None of the above**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

• The lens formula is** 1/v - 1/u= 1/f** where f is the focal length,u is the distance of the object,v is the distance of the image. Options A and C are the same and are wrong. Option B is also incorrect according to the right formulae.

Concept:__

__
 
• Lens: The transparent curved surface which is used to refract the light and make an image of any object placed in front of it is called a lens.

(1)/(v) - (1)/(u) = (1)/(f)

Where V = Distance of image from the optical center, U = Distance of object from the optical center.

questions.question: The width of each of five continuous classes in a frequency distribution is 5 and the lower class limit of the lowest class is 10. What is the upper-class limit of the highest class?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

As 5 is width for five consecutive classes.

⇒ 10 - 15

⇒ 15 - 20

⇒ 20 - 25

⇒ 25 - 30

⇒ 30 - 35

**∴ 35 is the upper-class limit of the highest class.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] __Alternate Method__**Given:

Lower class limit = 10

Width of each class = 5

**Calculation:**

Width till the upper class limit for a frequency distribution having 5 classes

⇒ 5 × 5 = 25 

The upper class limit of highest class =10 + 25 = 35

∴ 35 is the upper-class limit of the highest class.

questions.question: What day would it be on 19th April 2020?
questions.solution:
As 2000 is divisible by 400 the number of odd days is 0.

Number of leap years till 2019 = 4 (2004, 2008, 2012 and 2016)

Number of ordinary years till 2019 = 15

Number of odd days till 2020 = 15 + (4 × 2) = 23 odd days

Number of odd days in January 2020 = 3

Number of odd days in February 2020 (2020 is the leap year) = 1

Number of odd days in March 2020 = 3

Total number of odd days till 19th April 2020 = 23 + 3 + 3 + 1 + 19 = 49 odd days = 0 odd days

So, the day on 19th April 2020 is Sunday.

questions.question: If a current of 0.3 A is passed through a coil of resistance 418 ohms for 1 min, find the heat energy generated.
questions.solution:
__CONCEPT: __

__
 
• When an electric current is passed through a conductor, the conductor becomes hot after some time and produce heat.
 
• This happens due to the conversion of some electric energy passing through the conductor into heat energy. This effect of electric current is called the heating effect of the current or Joule heating effect.
 
• The appliances based on the heating effect of electric current work on both AC and DC supply.
 
• The amount of heat liberated can be given as
 
• H = frac{{Pt}}{{4.2}} 
 
• H = W = Pt = {I²}R

Electric current passing through conductor = IT

The power dissipated across copper coil = P

Work done by current = W

The resistance of wire = R

Heat dissipated because of current = H

time period = t

CALCULATION:__

Given data

⇒ The resistance of a coil = 418 ohms

⇒ Amount of time the current is passed = 1 × 60 = 60 sec

⇒ Current Passed = 0.3 A

→ As

H = I²RT where,

H = Heat Generated in Joules

I = Current in Amperes

R = Resistance of coil in Ohms

T = time in seconds

→ H = (0.3)² × 418 × 60

= 2257.2 joules

→ 1 calorie = 4.184 joules or

4.184 joules = 1 calorie

1 Joules = 1 / 4.184 calorie

2257.2 joules = (1 / 4.184) × 2257.2 calorie

= 539.48 ≅ 540 calorie

The heat energy generated is **__540 calorie__**

questions.question: The diagonals of a rhombus are 12 cm and 16 cm, respectively. The mid points of the sides of the rhombus are joined. Find the area of the thus formed figure.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/8e97027f2e9810840e64a7297277d3d68214c73dd51bfbfa8d9a73957edab18d.png] 

ABCD is a rhombus with AC = 12 cm and BD =16 cm.

P, Q, R, and S are the mid-points of the sides AB, BC, CD, and AD respectively. 

We have to find the area of the quadrilateral PQRS formed by joining the mid-points of the rhombus ABCD.

In ΔABD, S is the mid-point of AD and P is the mid-point of AB.

⇒ SP || BD

And, SP = 1/2 of BD (∴ Mid-point theorem)

⇒ SP = 1/2 × 16 = 8 cm

In ΔBCD, R is the mid-point of CD and Q is the mid-point of BC.

⇒ QR || BD and QR = 1/2 of BD

⇒ QR = 1/2 × 16 = 8 cm

SP || BD and QR || BD ⇒ SP || QR

Also, SP = QR = 8 cm

⇒ SPQR is a parallelogram.

Similarly, PQ = SR = 1/2 of AC

⇒ PQ = SR = 1/2 × 12 = 6 cm

Now,

BD || SP ⇒ SN || OM

AC || RS ⇒ ON || MS

⇒ NOMS is a parallelogram.

∠AOD = 90° (∴ Diagonals of a parallelogram bisect at right angle)

⇒ ∠MSN = 90° (∴ NOMS is a parallelogram)

⇒ PQRS is a rectangle.

Area of rectangle PQRS = SP × PQ = 8 × 6 = 48 sq cm

So, the area of the quadrilateral formed by joining the mid-points of the sides of rhombus ABCD is 48 sq cm.

questions.question: Which type of reproduction can bring greater diversity?
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Sexual__** reproduction allows for a greater genetic diversity through the process of Fertilisation.
 
• It involves the meiosis process which means a cell doubling its DNA, shuffling its genes and then dividing the shuffled DNA among four cells.
 
• Each resulting cell after dividing the shuffled DNA, or gamete, resulting from meiosis has only half the amount of DNA as the parent cell.
 
• Therefore, in order to form a new organism, two gametes - the sex cells, sperm, and egg - must fuse, further mixing the genes to produce more genetic diversity.

questions.question: The time duration that would elapse between 5:47 p.m of 21st June 2027 and 5:39 p.m. of 22ⁿd June 2028 is:
questions.solution:
We know that 1 day added in the leap year, 2028 is the leap year.

Therefore total number of days from 5:47 p.m 21st June 2027 to 5:47 p.m 21st June 2028 = 366 days (365 + 1 leap day)

Now from 5:47 p.m 21st June 2028 to 5:47 p.m 22ⁿd June 2028 = 1 day ⇒ 24 hrs.

But we have given the time till 5:39 pm on 22ⁿd June 2028 ⇒ 8 min. less that 24 hrs = 24 hrs – 8 min.

= 23 hrs 52 min.

Therefore the total time duration that will elapse between 5:47 p.m of 21st June 2027 and 5:39 p.m. of 22ⁿd June 2028 is 366 days 23 hours 52 mins.

Hence, “366 days 23 hours 52 mins” is the correct answer.

questions.question: When two trains are moving in opposite direction at a speed of 40 km/hr and 32 km/hr respectively, the faster train passes a man sitting in the slower train in 15 seconds. Find the length of the faster train.
questions.solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Relative speed of trains in opposite directions = 40 + 32 = 72 km/hr.

Convert the relative speed to m/s = 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s.

Since the faster train crosses a man (a point object) sitting in the slower train, the distance covered is equal to the length of the faster train.

Length of the faster train = Relative Speed × Time = 20 × 15 = 300 m.

**∴ The correct answer is 300 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 
 
• 
 
 
 Faster: 40 km/hr
 
• 
 

 
 
 
• 
 
 
 Slower: 32 km/hr
 
• 
 

 
 
 Man

 
 Opposite Direction: Add Speeds
 Relative Speed = 40 + 32 = 72 km/hr

**Given:**

Speed of the faster train = 40 km/hr

Speed of the slower train = 32 km/hr

Time taken by the faster train to pass the man = 15 seconds

**Formula Used:**

Relative speed (Opposite direction) = S₁ + S₂

Distance = Speed × Time

*Note: Since the man is a point object sitting in the slower train, the distance covered to pass him is exactly the length of the passing train.*

**Calculation:**

⇒ Relative Speed = 40 + 32 = 72 km/hr

⇒ Convert km/hr to m/s: 72 × (5/18) = 20 m/s

⇒ Length of the faster train = Relative speed in m/s × Time

⇒ Length of the faster train = 20 × 15 = 300 m

**∴ The correct answer is 300 m.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Relative Speed Concept

When two objects move in opposite directions, their relative speed is the sum of their individual speeds (S₁ + S₂). If moving in the same direction, it is the difference (S₁ − S₂).

Unit Conversion

To convert speed from km/hr to m/s, multiply the value by 5/18. Conversely, to convert m/s to km/hr, multiply by 18/5.

Passing a Point Object vs Platform

When a train passes a man, pole, or tree, the total distance covered is merely the length of the train. When it passes a stationary platform or bridge, the distance covered is the length of the train plus the length of the object.

questions.question:
Consider the following question and decide which of the statements is sufficient to answer the question.

Shiju has 10 bags that each weigh the same. What is the total weight of the 10 bags?

Statements:

1. One-third of the weight of each bag is 8 kg.

2. The bags contain rice.

options.text: Statement 1 and 2 together are not sufficient

questions.solution:
Weight of each bag is equal and there are 10 bags.

Let weight of each bag be x kg

Statement 1:

⇒ (1/3) × x = 8

⇒ x = 24

⇒ Total weight of 10 bags = 10 × 24 = 240 kg

So, Statement 1 is sufficient, but Statement 2 is irrelevant of the weight

∴ Statement 1 alone is sufficient.

questions.question: Shubhangi Swaroop became the first-ever female pilot to be inducted into the _______.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Shubhangi Swaroop**, a cadet from Uttar Pradesh, became the first woman pilot in the** Indian Navy.__**
 
• She is among the 328 cadets who passed out from the Indian Naval Academy's first batch of female officers.
 
• The first female officer was inducted in the force in 1991.

questions.question: ________ is an ore of mercury.
questions.solution:
__
 
• **Cinnabar __**is an ore of Hg (Mercury) and its Latin name is Hydrargyrum.
 
• It is the most important ore of mercury having a chemical composition of HgS (mercury sulphide).
 
• It is used as a pigment in jewelry and ornaments due to its bright red color and it is also not as poisonous as other forms of mercury.
 
• The atomic number of Mercury is 80.
